text: Still one of my favourite clips on youtube: the very first video recording of Kraftwerk live, from 1970! [VIDEO] (Those audience reactions!)

1978 Kraftwerk live performance of 2 songs: [LINK] Kraftwerk's first live recorded performance was in 1970: [VIDEO] How many people in the 1970 audience sensed that they were listening to something as significant as what it became?

Techno was started in Düsseldorf by Kraftwerk. [VIDEO] People found this very inspiring and created their own variants. The Detroit variant came along. The Chicago variant came along. The UK variant came along. But it all goes back to Kraftwerk.

text: "A lot of creative work is remixes" in no way conflicts with "That's pretty low-value creativity." Hiphop made using samples a fashion .
